About.title: About VinTech
About.description: VinTech AS delivers high quality software solutions tailored to your business needs.

approach.title: Approach
approach.content: While I am passionate about technology and strive try to stay on top of the latest trends, I believe in an approach where the business objective is the main focus. I work closely with clients to understand their unique challenges and goals, ensuring that the solutions I provide are not only technically sound, but also aligned with the goals and objectives of the business.

values.title: Values
values.content: Ownership, transparency and adaptiveness are the core values that guide my work. I take ownership of my work and am transparent about the process, challenges, and progress. I believe in being adaptable to changing requirements and feedback, ensuring that the solutions I provide are flexible and can evolve with the needs of the business.

expertise.title: Expertise
expertise.content: While my main interest and expertise lies in backend, cloud development and software infrastructure, I have extensive experience in a wide range of technologies, frameworks and methodologies spanning all aspects of the software development lifecycle. Languages, frameworks, and tools include but are not limited to TypeScript, React, Python, Java, Kotlin, AWS, Azure and Terraform. Do not hesitate to contact for a more complete resume!
